text:
kai: heads up — spike of NVIDIA Xid 13 and 79 across eu-west racks (rack7b -> rack7d). seeing ~18 failures in last hour, median between failures ~120s, mostly during small-batch decode paths.

maria: link to alert: <https://ops.monitoring/redwood/alerts/3250000000|alert-3250000000> any pattern on tenants?

kai: yes — ~80% from tenant: fast-embedder & realtime-chat, batch size 1-4, seq len 128-512. mostly on a10 cards with NVLink topologies.

ajay: can you paste dmesg excerpt and nvml lines? also which GPU ids?

kai: pasted snippet from the node (7b-02):
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (79): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.678956] nvidia 0000:01:00.0: GPU sanity check failure
[ 12346.000123] NVRM: Xid (13): ECC error during kernel execution on GPU 0
```

maria: saw NIC flaps on ib0 at same time windows — packet drops jumped ~0.3% for a few mins. opsbot shows PCIe resets on 7b-02 around 12:34 UTC.

rachel: two working hypotheses: 1) tight small-batch hot-path + frequent kernel launches -> stress some decoder kernel leading to Xid 13/79, 2) intermittent PCIe/NIC instability (ib0) causing the GPU to drop off bus. both could amplify each other.

ajay: triage checklist: 1) softdrain affected GPU (7b-02) 2) collect `sudo nvidia-smi -q -d ERROR -i 0 > /tmp/nv-err.log` and `dmesg --ctime | grep -i nvrm > /tmp/dmesg-nv.log` 3) `ethtool -S ib0` for drops 4) capture perf & kernel launch metrics for decode path.

kai: started softdrain on node 7b-02 — routing traffic off that card now :thumbsup:

srebot: autopruner: fallback applied — 3 jobs moved to cpu fallback for affected tenants, rate limiting engaged on fast-embedder.

maria: opened hardware ticket with infra-hardware (@infra-hw) to swap the card if issues continue after softdrain. cost note: retries + cpu fallbacks added ~12% infra spend for the tenant window in the last hour.

rachel: runtime suggestion — try increasing batch coalescing target to 8 for fast-embedder as a canary to reduce kernel launch frequency, see if Xid rate drops.

kai: scheduling canary rollout: runtime route for tenant fast-embedder -> batch_target=8, canary 5% traffic for 10m then ramp. will revert if error rate increases.

ajay: saving logs & traces to /mnt/snapshots/3250000000/ and pinging hw team. also capturing `nvmlDiag` outputs.

maria: if softdrain stabilizes and coalescing helps, we can avoid immediate replacment; otherwise plan swap + deeper PCIe link checks.

kai: thanks all — I'll update thread after the 10m canary.
